brief: Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities daily note for 8 Sep 2026. Stat of the day: systematic long/short funds are up 17% year to date and recorded their best month of the year. The note's one argued chain is oil. Goldman raises its Brent and WTI forecasts by $5, to $85 and $80 for Dec 2026 and to $80 and $75 for 2027, on a new assumption that Mideast shipping disruptions continue into 2027. It calls that upgrade modest for two reasons: OECD commercial land inventories, a key price driver, have barely drawn since the war began, reflecting a smaller than expected deficit amid market adaptation, and stock draws concentrated in OECD strategic reserves, on water and in China. Supply adaptation is assumed to continue, with production recovering gradually by 2027H2. The rest reports rather than argues. Buy-rated Robinhood's Rothera prediction markets venture has ranked 3rd to 5th globally by volume since its May launch and ran about $150mn annualized revenue in its first quarter, feeding above-consensus 2027E and 2028 forecasts. Planet Labs beat F2Q27 consensus and raised the low end of FY27 guidance while raising CapEx, and Goldman stays Neutral on valuation. US Labor Day observed, no major data.
